title: Redirect
description: An HTTP redirect from a path the site no longer serves. Created automatically when a published entry or a term changes slug, when terms are merged or retired, and by people. Snapshotted and published like every other node (RFC-0002).

from.description: Request path to redirect: starts with '/', no query, fragment, backslash or trailing slash (root excepted). Unique per site and locale; never a path the site currently serves.

locale.description: The locale whose URLs `from` belongs to (RFC-0033); absent means the site's default locale. `from` is the path inside that locale, without its prefix or domain. Unique per site and locale.

to.description: Target: a site path (may carry a query or fragment) or an absolute https URL. Protocol-relative ('//host') and backslash forms are rejected.

status.description: 301 (permanent) for slug changes, merges and retirements; 302 (temporary) only for manual redirects.

match.description: exact: only `from` itself. prefix: `from` and every path below it; the rest of the path is appended to `to` (archives: /tag/old/page/2 → /tag/new/page/2).

RedirectSource.description: The node whose earlier URL this redirect preserves (automatic redirects). Used to collapse chains on later renames and to list a node's old URLs.
